notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first only - direct curl fetch of robots.txt, homepage HTML, and Shopify /collections.json (paginated, 508 total collections) using a browser User-Agent. robots.txt is a standard Shopify file (disallows /admin,/cart,/checkout,/search,/account etc, allows everything else) with no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow - no block. No Playwright/CDP or Claude-in-Chrome needed; SSR HTML already contained full mega-menu markup and live product counts. TREE: built from the site's header mega-menu (<nav class="header__inline-menu">, panels 1-6: Indoor Lighting, Outdoor Lighting, Home Decor, Dried Botanicals, Shop By Room, Shop By Style, plus Bestsellers/New Arrivals/Lookbooks/Collections/Sale quick-links) cross-checked against the full /collections.json list (508 handles) and each candidate category page's own facet panel. Whispering Homes is a lighting + general home-decor + dried-botanicals brand; the mega-menu has no Storage or Organization section anywhere, and a keyword sweep of all 508 collection handles/titles (storage, basket, organizer, box, tray, drawer, shelf, rack, trunk, chest, caddy, hamper, sorter, wardrobe, closet, pantry, under-bed, laundry) found no genuine navigable storage category - the only 'storage'-named hit (Ceramic Storage Jars) is an orphan SEO collection (not linked in nav or on the parent Decorative Jars page) whose real site category is decorative jars/decor, not storage - so storage_rows is empty. The single Textile-qualifying node is Cushion Covers, listed under Home Decor in the mega-menu (/collections/cushion-covers); its page has only a price/product-type facet panel, no subcategory strip, so it stays a flat leaf (title/H1 'Designer Cushion Covers', canonical matches). Other cushion-cover variants seen in collections.json (cotton-cushion-covers, fancy-cushion-covers, floral-cushion-covers, large-cushion-covers, small-cushion-covers, embroidered-pillow-covers) are NOT linked from the mega-menu or from the Cushion Covers page itself - they only appear inside a giant embedded predictive-search JS array that lists literally every collection on the site (including hundreds of home-decor-products-in-<city> SEO pages, occasion pages like Diwali/Eid/Father's Day, and style/lookbook pages) - these are orphan programmatic-SEO landing pages, not real navigable subcategories, so per the View-All/Collections exclusion rule they were excluded to avoid inflating/duplicating the main Cushion Covers count. QTY: read directly from the rendered facet panel span id=ProductCountDesktop ("33 products") on https://www.whisperinghomes.com/collections/cushion-covers - exact site-displayed number, not paginated/estimated. EXCLUDED: Vases, Decor Accents, Wall Decor, Decorative Jars, Brass Decorative Items, Candle Holders (Decorative Home Accessories/Wall Decor, out of Textile+Storage scope); Dried Botanicals group (dried flowers/grasses/pampas - decorative, not textile/storage); Indoor/Outdoor Lighting (Lighting category); Shop By Room and Shop By Style panels (room/style landing aggregators per textile.md Sec 2 - room/style name alone does not create a category, and they only re-list products already covered under real categories); Wall Baskets / Grass Basket Wall Decor / Trinket Tray Lookbook / Decorative Trays (Wall Decor / Decorative Home Accessories per storage.md Sec5 and Sec24 - decorative, no meaningful storage function, not presented as Storage anywhere on the site); Bestsellers, New Arrivals, Lookbooks, Collections (Earthen/Victorian/Heirloom/Crystal/Minimal/Alabaster/Dhaat/Flower Pot/Chinoiserie/Candy), Clearance Sale, Open Box Sale (all View-All/marketing/collection pages, excluded per Sec27/Sec35 of both rule files); the hundreds of home-decor-products-in-<city-or-state> SEO pages (not real product categories, no nav placement).
